description: Source file defining a Jetpack Compose component for rendering Markdown-formatted chat messages. It includes functions to parse Markdown, render various Markdown block elements, inline styling, and embedded images from Base64 data within Android UI code.

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class encapsulating styles used for inline Markdown elements, such as code backgrounds and link colors.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a rendered Markdown table, distinguishing header rows and cell contents.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Data class representing an image embedded in Markdown with its MIME type and Base64-encoded data.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main composable function that takes Markdown text and renders it as styled chat message content.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Internal function to recursively render Markdown nodes into Compose UI components.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders a paragraph element, including inline images if detected.

methods.name: RenderBulletList
methods.description: Renders a bulleted list with appropriate indentation.

methods.name: RenderOrderedList
methods.description: Renders a numbered list with appropriate indentation.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders individual list items, including task list markers.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Renders Markdown tables, handling headers and rows.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Builds a list of table rows from a Markdown Table block.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads table header or body and returns a list of table rows.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Reads a single table row and its cells, returning a structured representation.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Creates an annotated string with inline styles based on a Markdown node subtree.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Appends styled text to an AnnotatedString.Builder based on Markdown node types.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Converts Markdown inline nodes to plain text.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Detects if a paragraph contains a standalone data URI image and parses it.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Extracts MIME type and Base64 data from a data URI.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Returns different text styles for headings based on level.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image from a Base64-encoded string within Compose UI, handling loading states.
